evidence: The 3D top view shows visible board surface between every body — C1/C5 left of U1, R5/D1 right of U1, the passives around SW1/SW2 — with no touching or near-touching parts.

USB-C J1 sits flush at the bottom-right edge with its receptacle opening outward and nothing between it and the edge, and J2 is a vertical THT header at the bottom-left edge with unobstructed top access.

The repeated SW1/SW2 button subcircuits are not identical (SW2's support passives sit in different relative positions than SW1's), and C2, R3/R4 and D1/R5 are scattered with no aligned rows or columns.
C1 and C5 designators overlap each other beside U1, R3/R4 are stacked on top of one another mid-board, and the label row below U1 (pins 15-26) collapses into an illegible jumble overlapping the pads.

Circuitry crowds the top-left quadrant while the bottom-center and most of the right half are large dead regions, and C2 is stranded mid-board far from the U1 power pins it serves with long ratsnest lines crossing the empty area.
